gruss_morgen.text: Morning. Fire's burning. Coffee too. All as it should be.

gruss_tag.text: Day. Berthold Ironhoof. I forge. The rest sorts itself out.

gruss_abend.text: Evening. The iron rests. Me, almost.

gruss_regen.text: Rain. Good for the meadow. Bad for the rust. Come to the fire.

gruss_freund.text: You. Good. Sit. For friends, the anvil stool is free. That's the good stool.

text: Good. Iron is patient. Me too.
One of us glows faster. Not saying who.
You come by often. I like that. Most only come when something's stuck.
You come anyway. That's... a lot. For me, that's a lot.
Know what's rare? Good iron. Know what's rarer? Good people.
You're good people. There. Now I've talked for a whole year.

quest_vergabe.text: Got something. Needs hands. Yours are attached, I see.

ablehnung.text: Fine. Iron waits. I wait with it.

quest_abgabe.text: Clean. Honest work. Here. Don't thank me, or it gets emotional.

geschenk_liebt.text: Oat thalers. My weakness. How did... never mind. Thanks. I mean it.

geschenk_mag.text: Hm. Good. I'll take it. Thanks.

geschenk_normal.text: Aha. Well. It has... shape. Thanks.

text: Mrs. Anvil? The anvil. Heirloom. Three generations of Ironhoofs.
My grandpa talked to her. My father talked to her. I talk to her.
She never answers. Best listener in the whole valley.
My best horseshoe? Not hanging on a wall. It's out there walking.
Years ago. Scrawny wild horse, broken hoof. Everyone said: let it be.
I forged all night. It still runs up in the hills today.
When the wind is right, you can hear it. Cling, clang. That's my masterpiece.
